issues.explanation: 「こうして」 is an adverb meaning “in this way”; 「こうする」 is not its appropriate dictionary lemma.
This is ordinary compositional language: the quantifier 「数」 and the loanword counter 「ページ」 should be separate segments.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 「数」 (lemma 数, kana すう, “several”) and 「ページ」 (lemma ページ, kana ページ, “page(s)”).

issues.explanation: 「皮肉」 is the noun “irony” or “sarcasm”; “sarcastic manner” is an awkward paraphrase rather than an individual-segment meaning.
